lines.differs: Same as Trustline NBFC: both set the payment timeframe for undisputed invoices at forty-five (45) days.
Worse for AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: undisputed invoices are payable within forty-five (45) days instead of thirty (30) days.
Worse for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: payment terms are forty-five (45) days instead of thirty (30) days.
Better for AtliQ than Trustline NBFC: does not impose a six-hour deadline to report security incidents.
Worse for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: requires compliance with RBI IT outsourcing directions and allows regulatory audits without reasonable notice restrictions.
Worse for AtliQ than Northwind Logistics: requires full RBI IT outsourcing compliance, local data storage and processing, and banking regulatory audit rights.
Same as Acme Retail Group: both cap liquidated damages for delays at 5% of the affected milestone fee at 0.5% per week.
Better for AtliQ than Brightwater Insurance Inc: liquidated damages are 0.5% per week capped at 5% of milestone fee, not 1% daily uncapped.
Better for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: liquidated damages are capped at 5% of the milestone fee at 0.5% per week instead of 1%.
Same as Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: client-specific deliverables vest upon payment while AtliQ retains its pre-existing tools and methodologies.
Same as Al Noor Hospitality Group: deliverables created specifically for client vest upon payment while AtliQ retains pre-existing tools and methodologies.
Same as Crestline Retail Inc: specific deliverables vest in client upon payment while AtliQ retains its pre-existing tools and methodologies.
Worse for AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: adds an uncapped liability exception for data protection breaches and caps liability at total fees instead of twelve months.
Worse for AtliQ than CareBridge Clinics Inc: liability for confidentiality, data protection, and fraud is completely uncapped rather than capped at two times annual fees.
Worse for AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: introduces uncapped liability carve-outs for confidentiality, data protection, and fraud.
Better for AtliQ than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: seat of arbitration is Pune instead of New Delhi.
Better for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: allows immediate arbitration without requiring a mandatory thirty-day pre-arbitration negotiation period.
Better for AtliQ than CloudSpan Technologies: governed by Indian law with arbitration in Pune instead of Singapore law and SIAC arbitration.
